title: Accuracy vs Precision Targets
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Clocks and Watches with AI
description: A dartboard target where the bullseye is the true time and each dot is a clock reading; bias and spread sliders show the difference between accurate and precise clocks.

learningObjectives: Differentiate accuracy (closeness to the true time) from precision (consistency of readings) using a clock-error analogy

keyQuestions: Which slider moves the average away from the bullseye?
Can a clock be precise but not accurate?
commonMisconceptions: Accuracy and precision mean the same thing
A clock with tightly grouped readings must be correct
assessmentOpportunities: Classify a target picture and name the slider that caused it
Explain whether a clock that is always 5 s fast is accurate or precise
